newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds rise but widen to Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds rise but widen to Treasuries.

text.p: Buoyed by benign inflation and retail sales data, U.S. mortgage-backed securities gained as much as half a point in some coupons on Tuesday.
Spreads over Treasuries widened about four basis points across the board, as the 10-year note rose a stronger 22/32.
Traders generally said market sentiment improved and sell-side activity sped up.
"There were a couple of deals priced," one trader said. "A couple of upsizes (expanded REMICs) hit the tape," he added.
